name: Differential Transformer
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
problem: Softmax attention is a convex combination of value vectors, so noise or distracting context in the values is averaged into every output - the mechanism by which irrelevant context degrades key-information retrieval and induces hallucination.
mechanism: Differential attention: compute attention as the difference of two softmax attention maps - lambda times softmax(Q1 K1^T) V1 MINUS softmax(Q2 K2^T) V2 - so the subtraction cancels the noise-like component and leaves the signal. Implemented with efficient kernel-level support so the doubled attention cost is manageable; the subtraction also reduces activation outliers, which matters for quantisation.
speedup_reported: NOT A PERFORMANCE CLAIM. The abstract reports quality and robustness benefits: long-context modelling, key information retrieval, hallucination mitigation in QA and summarisation, more accurate AND more permutation-robust in-context learning, and reduced activation outliers. No speedup figure, no baseline engine. The architecture does more work than softmax attention (two attention maps instead of one), so the honest framing is a quality/robustness trade, not a free win.
